decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY capturing the revised keyword sources, required examples, prohibited generic terms, and keyword usage rule; no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Changing the reference basis for keyword identification does not necessarily alter the existing direct, strong, viral opening-hook requirements.
The CPL explanation motivates the keyword correction but does not change the existing conversion objective, target CPL, or optimization priority.
The revised source material for keyword identification does not change the required testimonial format or testimonial content source.
The Hindi-only instruction is an independent decision already represented under this candidate; it is not a consequence of changing the reference basis.
The source does not change the audience age range or Indian target market.
Revising the creative reference basis does not alter the freelancer's full-service production responsibility or supplied production elements.
The source does not change the number, duration, or aspect ratios of the required video outputs.
The keyword-reference change does not modify the required organic call to action.
The winning transcript and last reference are specified as keyword sources, not as a replacement for the existing product-benefit source material.
The source contains no decision about audio levels, measurement conventions, or advertising mix standards.
The revised reference basis for script keywords does not change the required editing pace or cut standard.
